title: expTerm(0) = 1 exactly, as a literal CReal equality
statement: Eq CReal (expTerm 0) CReal.one -- not merely Equiv, a literal Eq: expTerm(n) is defined as embed(normalize(1, n!, proof)), and at n=0 this normalizes (via Rat.normalize's own defining computation, Nat.gcd 1 1 = 1) to the same Rat term CReal.one embeds, closed by a congruence chain (req_congr_creal) from that self-normalization identity.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.expTerm_zero_eq_one : Eq.{1} CReal (CReal.expTerm AxNat.zero) CReal.one

evidence.supports: CReal.expTerm_zero_eq_one is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- expTerm_zero_eq_one 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^CReal\.expTerm_zero_eq_one[[:space:]]'
